hypothesis_solved_when.H1: a test that requests a spawn via the HTTP route and then, without calling a worker function directly and without a DB edit, observes a started child or an explicit rejection with a reason
hypothesis_solved_when.H2: reservation, measured use and release are separately observable; a child that never started or was aborted releases its reservation; missing metering stays null
hypothesis_solved_when.H3: the normal completion route updates the spawn status, or the field is provably derived and never used as an independent truth; the proof-run repairs no state the normal route should have written
hypothesis_solved_when.H4: per executor it is recorded which boundary is technically enforced (uid, sandbox, network, worktree) and which is only a prompt warning, with a test on the enforced boundary
hypothesis_solved_when.H5: selection, delivery, load in the runtime and effect are four separate observations for the same content hash
hypothesis_solved_when.H6: per learning component the fitness contract has an independent outcome, a fair comparison and a decision rule, or is honestly measured_no_selection / unmeasured / circular
hypothesis_solved_when.H7: configured, actually triggered, poller reachable and work progressed are four separate signals, each with its own unknown state
hypothesis_solved_when.H8: source, synthetic status, commit, freshness and analysis method survive into the explainer and the evidence export, with a test that follows a synthetic row to the output
hypothesis_solved_when.H9: assignment, scan, verification, fix and retest are each bound to the right artefact, commit, scope, environment and time window; the live part stays BLOCKED without DjimitSec access
hypothesis_solved_when.H10: per recurring loop cost and delivered value are visible side by side with a denominator, and repetition without new information is counted as such

rule: changing any list or criterion after a result is a recorded deviation in REPORT.md, never a silent redefinition
